activities.name: Evening stroll around Gadisar Lake — gentle walk with lake views, perfect for a relaxed first evening

meals.breakfast: At hotel — simple Indian breakfast (poha or upma) served with tea

lunch.description: Light thali with dal, roti, and seasonal sabzi; enjoy near Gadisar Lake — approx 1 km from hotel
lunch.location_note: near Gadisar Lake — approx 1 km from base

dinner.description: Local highlight – dal baati churma served in a traditional courtyard restaurant
Family‑friendly spot – plain dal, soft roti and mixed vegetable sabzi in a clean sit‑down eatery
Premium experience – rooftop dining with sunset view, offering saffron‑infused biryani and gourmet desserts

days.notes: Arrival via private car from Jodhpur; check‑in early, unwind. Evening walk is low‑impact, suitable for a moderate pace.

activities.name: Guided heritage tour of Jaisalmer Fort (Sonar Quila) — expert guide, includes entry fee and audio commentary
Visit Patwon ki Haveli — free entry, explore the ornate courtyards and frescoes at your own speed

meals.breakfast: At hotel — warm masala chai with vegetable paratha

lunch.description: Thali with ker sangri, bajra roti and cucumber raita; eat near the Fort entrance — approx 0.5 km walk
lunch.location_note: near Jaisalmer Fort — approx 0.5 km from base

dinner.description: Local highlight – ker sangri tadka with bajra roti in a heritage‑styled dhaba
Family‑friendly spot – plain dal, soft rice and a mild vegetable curry in a comfortable sit‑down venue
Premium experience – candlelit courtyard dinner featuring mushroom masala, saffron pulao and artisanal desserts

days.notes: Morning tour is moderate walking (≤20 min continuous). Afternoon free for shopping or relaxing at the hotel.

activities.name: Camel safari + sunset desert camp (4‑hour package) — includes camel ride, cultural performance, dinner and overnight stay in a semi‑luxury tent

meals.breakfast: At hotel — fresh fruit, yogurt, and toasted bread with jam

lunch.description: Simple vegetarian thali with dal, rice, and seasonal veggies; enjoy at a dhaba on the road to Sam dunes
lunch.location_note: on the highway to Sam dunes — approx 10 km from Jaisalmer

dinner.description: Local highlight – desert‑style dal baati churma served around a campfire
Family‑friendly spot – mild paneer butter masala with soft naan in the camp’s communal kitchen
Premium experience – private tent dinner with thandai‑flavored dessert and live Rajasthani folk music

days.notes: Leave Jaisalmer by 10 AM, arrive at camp for camel ride by 2 PM. Night temperatures drop to ~5 °C; bring warm layers. Camp provides basic bathroom facilities.

activities.name: Morning visit to Khuri Dunes (optional) — quieter dunes, short sand walk and photo session
Return transfer to Jodhpur airport/train station

meals.breakfast: Camp breakfast — warm milk, biscuits, and boiled eggs

lunch.description: Veg pulao with raita and a side of fresh salad; stop near Jaisalmer city outskirts
lunch.location_note: on the return route to Jaisalmer — approx 15 km from camp

dinner.description: Local highlight – simple khichdi with ghee and papad in a city café (if flight is late)
Family‑friendly spot – plain dal, soft rice and gentle carrot sabzi at a clean restaurant near the bus stand
Premium experience – rooftop lounge offering grilled vegetables, paneer tikka and a glass of fine Rajasthani wine

days.notes: If departure is later in the evening, you may stay another night in Jaisalmer; otherwise head straight to the airport. Keep travel documents handy for the 4‑hour drive back.

warnings: Camel‑ride scams near fort gates: only book rides through your hotel or RTDC‑registered operators; refuse unsolicited offers.
Desert‑camp bait‑and‑switch: verify camp photos via video call, read recent reviews, and confirm bathroom facilities before paying.
Transport price inflation: agree on fares in advance, use hotel‑recommended drivers, and avoid unmarked vehicles.
Medical facilities are basic; for serious issues you may need evacuation to Jodhpur (≈290 km). Carry a travel‑first‑aid kit.

Camel ride scam near fort gates: offers of 'free' or ₹50 rides that escalate to ₹500–1,500; mitigation – book only through your hotel or an RTDC‑registered operator at Sam and refuse all unsolicited camel/horse approaches in fort lanes.

Luxury desert camp bait‑and‑switch: packages ₹3,000–8,000/person using polished stock photos deliver basic canvas tents with shared bathrooms; mitigation – book camps with recent verified Google/TripAdvisor reviews showing actual guest photos, call directly for a WhatsApp video of the tent interior, avoid aggregator packages that do not name the specific camp.

Transport price inflation: auto‑rickshaws within town ₹60–100, railway station to fort ~₹80–100, private cab to Sam (full day, dunes + sunset + return) ₹1,200–1,800, shared jeep to Sam ₹80–100/seat; mitigation – agree on fare before starting, use hotel‑recommended drivers, avoid unmarked vehicles.

Medical facilities are basic; Jaisalmer District Government Hospital handles only minor emergencies. For serious cardiac, trauma or paediatric cases, plan stabilization and transfer to Jodhpur (~290 km, 4 h). Carry a basic travel first‑aid kit for desert stays.
Desert cuisine relies on dried, preserved ingredients; fresh produce is limited outside the city core and spice levels are high by default. Request 'kam mirch' (less chilli) for milder taste.
Vegetarian food is widely available; the fort area is predominantly vegetarian. Plain dal and roti can be requested at fort restaurants and camp kitchens for simple meals.
Avoid unsolicited 'free' camel or horse offers near fort gates – they are a known trust issue that leads to price escalation.

Desert experience – camel safari and overnight camp at Sam dunes fulfill the ‘desert’ theme you requested.
Mid‑range budget – activities, meals and transport are selected to stay within a medium budget while still offering a few premium touches.
